open_questions: Chemistry is recorded from SDS DL2-15237.pdf, Section 3: Distillates (petroleum), hydrotreated heavy paraffinic; CAS 64742-54-7. Final source-level verification remains pending.
Specific gravity at 15/4°C is dimensionless and must not be transcribed directly as absolute density.
CCS for Ultra-S 6 is recorded in Tier 1 as 3,850 mPa.s at -30 °C (ASTM D5293) from the current S-OIL Lube Base Oil web page; the archived 2009 sheet DL2-11177.pdf prints no CCS (2026-10 audit).
Final source-level reconciliation between DL2-11177.pdf and SDS DL2-15237.pdf remains pending.

API Group (2026-10 audit): previously recorded as 'Group III' (Reported, no source; printed_text 'aramcoULTRA (Group III); S-OIL states Ultra-S and aramcoULTRA have the same properties'; note 'Classification supported by manufacturer-published Ultra-S/aramcoULTRA equivalence; not directly stated in the historical grade-specific SDS.'). No archived or public S-OIL document classifies Ultra-S 6 directly, so the field is now Missing. Indirect evidence only, not a classification of Ultra-S: (1) S-OIL states 'Ultra-S base oil is S-OIL's own brand product and has the same properties with armcoULTRA base oil' and lists identical typical properties for Ultra-S 6 and aramcoULTRA 6 (https://www.s-oil.com/en/energy/LubeBaseOil.aspx, undated, retrieved 2026-10-21); (2) the Aramco base-oil catalog 2024 p.25 lists aramcoULTRA 6 as API Base Oil Category Group III (https://www.aramco.com/-/media/downloads/creating-value/base-oils/aramco-base-oil-catalog-2024.pdf). Confirm the API Group of Ultra-S 6 with S-OIL.
